annotations.title: See what I'm cooking this week

description: Returns the dinners currently set as This Week in the user's Chop It app, with recipe links: the week they are cooking now. Answers 'what's for dinner tonight?' or 'what's on this week?' without planning anything new. Drafts and Saved Weeks do not change it. Returns shoppingListId for an existing matching owned snapshot, or a read-only week: reference for an app-created week without a chat draft. App-week reads use saved servings and current Pantry; browser-only ticks, extras and serving overrides are unavailable; read it with get_shopping_list for the latest revision, line IDs and Pantry coverage. A null ID with none/stale/unavailable status is not permission to create a list. Discovery never creates or refreshes shopping data. Read-only. Requires a linked Chop It account.
name: get_my_week

shoppingListId.description: Owned shopping reference for these dinners. week: references derive read-only requirements from the app week; browser-only ticks, extras and serving overrides are unavailable. Read with get_shopping_list; never create during discovery.

title: See what I'm cooking this week
